mapper.sql: JOIN sales_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id AND o.order_status IN ('Paid', 'Shipped', 'Completed')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS productCount, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS totalQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(oi.item_amount), 0) AS totalAmount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(oi.item_amount), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.quantity), 0), 2) AS avgPrice, MAX(o.paid_at) AS dataDate FROM sales_order_item oi

SELECT p.id AS productId, p.product_code AS productCode, p.product_name AS productName, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS quantity, COALESCE(SUM(oi.item_amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orderCount FROM sales_order_item oi
JOIN product p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.product_code, p.product_name ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

/* 品类名直接取 product_category（已数据治理：id=7 与 22 统一为'服装鞋靴'，无同义分裂） */ SELECT COALESCE(pc.category_name, '未分类') AS categoryName, MIN(pc.id) AS categoryId, COALESCE(SUM(oi.item_amount), 0) AS amount, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS quantity FROM sales_order_item oi
JOIN product p ON p.id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category pc ON pc.id = p.category_id GROUP BY categoryName ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN p.unit_price < 100 THEN '100 元以下' WHEN p.unit_price < 500 THEN '100-500 元' WHEN p.unit_price < 1000 THEN '500-1000 元' WHEN p.unit_price < 5000 THEN '1000-5000 元' ELSE '5000 元以上' END AS band, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS productCount, COALESCE(SUM(oi.item_amount), 0) AS amount FROM product p LEFT JOIN sales_order_item oi ON oi.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN sales_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id AND o.order_status IN ('Paid', 'Shipped', 'Completed') GROUP BY band ORDER BY MIN(p.unit_price)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.item_amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM sales_order_item oi
